rejection_summary.title: The Roundup: No Way Out
rejection_summary.reason: Although the sequel has well-choreographed melee fights, RogerEbert.com describes episodic thrills and a substantial procedural component; Nerdly explicitly reports fewer action set pieces than in the earlier films and more time devoted to police procedure. This disagreement with more enthusiastic descriptions makes whole-runtime action density too uncertain for a high-density shortlist. The film is not rejected for its year, cast or title alone.
